(b) THEN ONE Markdown table consistent with the Lock: - [Source Word] | [Morphology] | [Reference Equivalent] | [Contextual Definition] | [Grammatical Role] Source Text: 7 Tant' è amara che poco è più morte; 8 ma per trattar del ben ch'i' vi trovai, 9 dirò de l'altre cose ch'i' v'ho scorte. Reference Translation (provided): So bitter is it that death is little more. But in order to treat of the good that there I found, I will tell of the other things that I have seen there.

**(a) Interpretation Lock FIRST – one bullet per source line**
- **Line 7 “Tant' è amara che poco è più morte;”** **Locked Meaning:** The thing being described (the present circumstance) is *bitter* to a degree that is **just slightly less** than the bitterness of *death*. - **Entities:** - **A** = *the bitterness of the described thing* (the subject of *è amara*). - **B** = *death* (conceptualised as a benchmark of bitterness). - **Relation:** B > A, with the comparative degree marked by the adverb **poco** (“a little”). - **Predicate‑Argument Structure:** - *è amara* – copular predicate, subject implicit (the thing). - *che* introduces a result/comparative clause: *poco è più morte* – “death is a little more (bitter)”. - **Modifier Scope:** *poco* scopes the comparative *più* and applies to the whole clause *è più morte*; it does **not** modify *amara* directly.
- **Line 8 “ma per trattar del ben ch'i' vi trovai,”** **Locked Meaning:** The speaker, **I**, intends **in order to** discuss (*per trattar*) the **good** (*del ben*) **that I found there** (*ch'i' vi trovai*). - **Predicate‑Argument Structure:** - *per* + infinitive *trattar* – purpose clause, subject = *I* (understood). - Direct object of *trattar* = *del ben* (“the good”). - Relative clause *ch'i' vi trovai* modifies *ben*: “that I found there”. - **Modifier Scope:** The relative clause restricts *ben*; *per* marks the purpose of the forthcoming discourse.
- **Line 9 “dirò de l'altre cose ch'i' v'ho scorte.”** **Locked Meaning:** The speaker, **I**, will **tell** (*dirò*) **about the other things** (*de l'altre cose*) **that I have seen there** (*ch'i' v'ho scorte*). - **Predicate‑Argument Structure:** - *dirò* – future‑tense verb, subject = *I*. - Prepositional object *de l'altre cose* (“of the other things”). - Relative clause *ch'i' v'ho scorte* modifies *cose*: “that I have seen there”. - **Modifier Scope:** The relative clause limits *cose* to those the speaker has personally observed; *de* introduces the complement of *dirò*.
